title: Spot the difference: park
prompt: Three things changed between the two park pictures. Which list names all three changes?
explanation: Compare the two pictures bit by bit: The frog changed colour from green to plain, the elephant changed colour from gray to plain and the moon vanished. Nothing else is different.
reviewNote: Independent review passed: answer re-derived from scene data, difficulty and safety checked. Published under the owner's 18 Nov 2026 direction.
